46523-the-spruce-street-tragedy-or-old-s.creator: Unknown
46523-the-spruce-street-tragedy-or-old-s.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. "And so do I," exclaimed Stricket. "It makes me mad even now when I think of the way they managed such splendid cases as the Jennie Cramer, Rose Ambler, and half a dozen others like them."

arxiv-2012-04671.title: Information Transfer with a Gravitating Bath
arxiv-2012-04671.creator: Hao Geng a , Andreas Karch a,b , Carlos Perez-Pardavila b , Suvrat Raju c , Lisa Randall d , Marcos Riojas b , Sanjit Shashi b
arxiv-2012-04671.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Hao Geng a , Andreas Karch a,b , Carlos Perez-Pardavila b , Suvrat Raju c , Lisa Randall d , Marcos Riojas b , Sanjit Shashi b. Late-time dominance of entanglement islands plays a critical role in addressing the information paradox for black holes in AdS coupled to an asymptotic non-gravitational bath. A natural question is how this observation can be extended to gravitational systems.

arxiv-2107-13702.title: No Activity Among 13 Centaurs Discovered in the Pan-STARRS1 Detection Database
arxiv-2107-13702.creator: Eva Lilly, Henry Hsieh, James Bauer, Jordan Steckloff, Peter Jevčák, Robert Weryk, Richard J. Wainscoat, Charles Schambeau
arxiv-2107-13702.description: Abstract Centaurs are small bodies orbiting in the giant planet region which were scattered inwards from their source populations beyond Neptune. Some members of the population display comet-like activity during their transition through the solar system, the source of which is not well understood.

arxiv-2302-07722.title: The Half-Volume Spectrum of a Manifold
arxiv-2302-07722.creator: Liam Mazurowski, Xin Zhou
arxiv-2302-07722.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Liam Mazurowski, Xin Zhou. We define the half-volume spectrum { ω ~ p } p ∈ ℕ \{{\tilde{\omega}_{p}\}_{p\in\mathbb{N}}} of a closed manifold ( M n + 1 , g ) (M^{n+1},g) . This is analogous to the usual volume spectrum of M M , except that we restrict to p p -sweepouts whose slices each enclose half the volume of M M . We prove that the Weyl law continues to hold for the half-volume spectrum.

arxiv-2404-11324.title: Weighted-Average Least Squares for Negative Binomial Regression
arxiv-2404-11324.creator: Kevin Huynh
arxiv-2404-11324.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Kevin Huynh. Model averaging methods have become an increasingly popular tool for improving predictions and dealing with model uncertainty, especially in Bayesian settings. Recently, frequentist model averaging methods such as information theoretic and least squares model averaging have emerged. This work focuses on the issue of covariate uncertainty where managing the computational resources is key: The model space grows exponentially with the number of covariates such that averaged models must often be approximated.

arxiv-2405-18582.title: Automatic Calibration for an Open-source Magnetic Tactile Sensor
arxiv-2405-18582.creator: Lowiek Van den Stockt, Remko Proesmans, Francis wyffels
arxiv-2405-18582.description: Abstract Tactile sensing can enable robots to perform complex, contact-rich tasks. Magnetic sensors offer accurate three-axis force measurements while using affordable materials. Calibrating such a sensor involves either manual data collection, or automated procedures with precise mounting of the sensor relative to an actuator.

arxiv-2406-10417.title: Enhanced Intrusion Detection System for Multiclass Classification in UAV Networks
arxiv-2406-10417.creator: Safaa Menssouri 1 , Mamady Delamou 1 , Khalil Ibrahimi 2 , El Mehdi Amhoud 1
arxiv-2406-10417.description: Abstract Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) have become increasingly popular in various applications, especially with the emergence of 6G systems and networks. However, their widespread adoption has also led to concerns regarding security vulnerabilities, making the development of reliable intrusion detection systems (IDS) essential for ensuring UAVs safety and mission success. This paper presents a new IDS for UAV networks.

arxiv-2411-09266.title: How Good is ChatGPT at Audiovisual Deepfake Detection: A Comparative Study of ChatGPT, AI Models and Human Perception
arxiv-2411-09266.creator: Sahibzada Adil Shahzad, Ammarah Hashmi, Yan-Tsung Peng, Yu Tsao, Hsin-Min Wang
arxiv-2411-09266.description: Abstract Multimodal deepfakes involving audiovisual manipulations are a growing threat because they are difficult to detect with the naked eye or using unimodal deep learning-based forgery detection methods. Audiovisual forensic models, while more capable than unimodal models, require large training datasets and are computationally expensive for training and inference.

arxiv-2505-15621.title: DSCodeBench: A Realistic Benchmark for Data Science Code Generation
arxiv-2505-15621.creator: Shuyin Ouyang, Dong Huang, Jingwen Guo, Zeyu Sun, Qihao Zhu, Jie M. Zhang
arxiv-2505-15621.description: Abstract We introduce DSCodeBench, a new benchmark designed to evaluate large language models (LLMs) on complicated and realistic data science code generation tasks. DSCodeBench consists of 1,000 carefully constructed problems sourced from realistic problems from GitHub across ten widely used Python data science libraries.

arxiv-2507-02753.title: Diffusive charge transport in the gapped 1D Hubbard model at all finite temperatures
arxiv-2507-02753.creator: J. M. P. Carmelo, P. D. Sacramento
arxiv-2507-02753.description: Abstract Studies relying on hydrodynamic theory and Kardar-Parisi-Zhang (KPZ) scaling have found that in the one-dimensional Hubbard model spin and charge transport are for all temperatures T > 0 T>0 anomalous superdiffusive at zero magnetic field, h = 0 h=0 , and zero chemical potential, μ = 0 \mu=0 , respectively.

arxiv-2510-26027.title: Enhancing Temporal Understanding in Video-LLMs through Stacked Temporal Attention in Vision Encoders
arxiv-2510-26027.creator: Ali Rasekh, Erfan Bagheri Soula, Omid Daliran, Simon Gottschalk, Mohsen Fayyaz
arxiv-2510-26027.description: Abstract Despite significant advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), understanding complex temporal dynamics in videos remains a major challenge. Our experiments show that current Video Large Language Model (Video-LLM) architectures have critical limitations in temporal understanding, struggling with tasks that require detailed comprehension of action sequences and temporal progression.

arxiv-2606-17090.creator: Spencer H. Bryngelson

plos-pone-0003749.creator: Gabriel G. Perron, Sylvain Quessy, Graham Bell
plos-pone-0003749.description: PLOS ONE research article. The population genetics of pathogenic bacteria has been intensively studied in order to understand the spread of disease and the evolution of virulence and drug resistance. However, much less attention has been paid to bacterial carriage populations, which inhabit hosts without p

pmc-10864939.title: Efficacy of Extracorporeal Shock Wave and Pulse Electromagnetic Field Therapies in Calcaneal Spurs
pmc-10864939.creator: Gülşah Yaşa Öztürk, Ayşegül Yetişir
pmc-10864939.description: Background: Various treatment methods are available for calcaneal spur, which can cause disability. Objective: To evaluate the efficacy of pulsed electromagnetic field therapy (PEMFT) added to extracorporeal shock wave therapy (ESWT) on pain and functional capacity in treating calcaneal spurs.

pmc-11281951.title: Anti-proliferative impact of resveratrol on gingival fibroblasts from juvenile hyaline fibromatosis
pmc-11281951.creator: Işıl Saygun, Melis Özgül Slezovic, Cansel Köse Özkan, Vahdi Umut Bengi, Pınar Elçi, Muhittin Serdar, Alpdogan Kantarci
pmc-11281951.description: AimResveratrol is a natural polyphenolic compound with biological activities such as anti-inflammation and antioxidation. Its anti-fibrotic effect has been experimentally demonstrated in the pancreas and liver. This study aims to determine the anti-proliferative effect of resveratrol on fibroblasts obtained from hyperplastic gingival tissues from a patient diagnosed with Juvenile Hyaline Fibromatosis (JHF).

pmc-11341857.title: Enhancing soil health, microbial count, and hydrophilic methomyl and hydrophobic lambda-cyhalothrin remediation with biochar and nano-biochar
pmc-11341857.creator: Kanchana Chandi, Patchimaporn Udomkun, Thirasant Boonupara, Puangrat Kaewlom
pmc-11341857.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Pesticide contamination and soil degradation present significant challenges in agricultural ecosystems, driving extensive exploration of biochar (BC) and nano-biochar (NBC) as potential solutions. This study examines their effects on soil properties, microbial communities, and the fate of two key pesticides: the hydrophilic methomyl (MET) and the hydrophobic lambda-cyhalothrin (LCT), at different concentrations (1%, 3%, and 5% w w−1) in agricultural soil. Through a carefully designed seven-week black bean pot experiment, the results indicated that the addition of BC/NBC significantly influenced soil dynamics.

pmc-11434658.title: The Role of ADCY1 in Regulating the Sensitivity of Platinum-Based Chemotherapy in NSCLC
pmc-11434658.creator: Ting Zou, Jun-Yan Liu, Zhao-Qian Liu, Di Xiao, Juan Chen
pmc-11434658.description: Lung cancer has the highest fatality rate among malignant tumors in the world. Finding new biomarkers of drug resistance is of great importance in the prognosis of lung cancer patients. We found that the polymorphisms of Adenylate Cyclase 1 (ADCY1) are significantly associated with platinum-based chemotherapy resistance in lung cancer patients in our previous research.

pmc-11640871.title: Impact of Missense Mutations on AFB1 Metabolism in Bovine Cytochrome P4503A Isoforms: A Computational Mutagenesis and Molecular Docking Analysis
pmc-11640871.creator: Ludovica Montanucci, Silvia Iori, Maija Lahtela-Kakkonen, Marianna Pauletto, Mery Giantin, Mauro Dacasto
pmc-11640871.description: Cytochrome P450 3A (CYP3A) enzymes catalyze the metabolism of a wide range of endogenous and exogenous compounds. Genetic variations in the 3 CYP3A isoforms (CYP3A28, CYP3A74, and CYP3A76) may influence their expression and activity, leading to inter-individual differences in xenobiotic metabolism.

pmc-11657606.title: Systematic review on the cost of seasonal malaria chemoprevention (SMC)
pmc-11657606.creator: Anika Ruisch, Miranda Iodice, Ishani Mathur, Sara Harris, Damian G. Walker, Richmond Owusu, Justice Nonvignon, Colin Gilmartin
pmc-11657606.description: BackgroundImplemented in 17 countries to date, seasonal malaria chemoprevention (SMC) is a recommended strategy to prevent childhood malaria in areas with seasonal transmission of P. falciparum through monthly administration of antimalarial medicines. Understanding the costs and resource requirements of SMC delivery is necessary for effective planning and resource allocation.

pmc-11915519.title: Safety and Efficacy of Prophylactic Topical Steroid Administration for Enfortumab Vedotin–related Cutaneous Toxicity
pmc-11915519.creator: Yuki Kita, Takashi Nomura, Saeko Nakajima, Satoru Yonekura, Kaoru Murakami, Takayuki Sumiyoshi, Kimihiko Masui, Takayuki Goto, Ryoichi Saito, Kenji Kabashima, Takashi Kobayashi
pmc-11915519.description: Enfortumab vedotin (EV) is used to treat unresectable/metastatic urothelial carcinoma but often causes cutaneous toxicity (EVRCT) because of Nectin4 expression in the skin, which reduces patients’ quality of life and can lead to dose adjustments or discontinuation. We explored whether applying topical steroids prophylactically to intertriginous areas could prevent EVRCT.

pmc-12427734.title: Problematic Social Media Use and Its Relationship with Breastfeeding Behaviors and Anxiety in Social Media-Native Mothers: A Mixed-Methods Study
pmc-12427734.creator: Hülya Tosun, Hava Özkan
pmc-12427734.description: Background/Objectives: Social Media Use has become an integral part of contemporary motherhood, with potential effects on maternal mental health and breastfeeding behaviors. This study aimed to examine the relationship between problematic social media use, anxiety levels, infant feeding attitudes, and feeding intentions among social media-native mothers. Methods: A mixed-methods design was used with 222 mothers.

pmc-12591893.title: Evaluation of left atrial function in patients with severe aortic stenosis with preserved ejection fraction based on real-time three-dimensional automated left atrial quantification technique
pmc-12591893.creator: Yuxin Li, Tianle Yu, Jiacheng Li, Yumeng Wu, Luyao Yin, Tingting Shao, Hongtao Lu, Chao Wang, Li Xue
pmc-12591893.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundAortic stenosis (AS) is a prevalent valvular heart disease with increasing incidence in aging populations. Mild AS is often asymptomatic with a favorable prognosis, whereas symptomatic severe AS progresses rapidly and carries high mortality. Although conventional echocardiography typically uses left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) to assess left ventricular (LV) systolic function, its sensitivity in detecting subclinical myocardial damage in AS patients remains limited.

pmc-13065922.title: NR2F6 deletion revives CAR-T cell function and induces antigen-agnostic immune memory in solid tumors
pmc-13065922.creator: Dominik Humer, Victoria Klepsch, Dietmar Rieder, Isabel Hölzl, Daniel Schreiber, Viktor Lang, Jiří Koutník, Sebastian Peer, Tajana Sajinovic, Viana Wille, Anna Fürst, Dragana Savic, Gabriel Diem, Wilfried Posch, Ira-Ida Skvortsova, Anne Krogsdam, Sieghart Sopper, Sebastian Kobold, Zlatko Trajanoski,
pmc-13065922.description: CAR-T cell therapy is effective in hematologic malignancies but remains challenging in solid tumors owing to antigen heterogeneity and tumor microenvironment-induced exhaustion. Here, gene editing of the nuclear receptor NR2F6 restores CAR-T cell functionality, sustaining a TCF1⁺ progenitor-exhausted phenotype, enhancing metabolic fitness, and preserving cytotoxic potency under chronic antigen exposure.

pmc-13101237.title: Factors associated with unmet healthcare needs among community-dwelling older adults in South Korea: a cross-sectional study using KNHANES 2023
pmc-13101237.creator: Heeyoung Hwang, Kyeongmin Jang
pmc-13101237.description: BackgroundUnmet healthcare needs (UHN), defined as perceived need for medical care that is not obtained, are a key indicator of access barriers among older adults. Using recent nationally representative data, this study examined factors associated with UHN among community-dwelling older adults in South Korea within Andersen’s behavioral model framework.

pmc-13218223.title: Confidence interval construction for multivariable truncated spline logistic model (MTSLM)
pmc-13218223.creator: Afiqah Saffa Suriaslan, I Nyoman Budiantara, Vita Ratnasari, Dursun Aydin
pmc-13218223.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This study highlights the construction of confidence intervals within the Multivariable Truncated Spline Logistic Model (MTSLM). Its truncated spline function allow flexible modeling of nonlinear relationships across sub-intervals that conventional logistic regression cannot capture. A simulation study is conducted to validate the performance of proposed method, and Human Development Index (HDI) data in Indonesia are used as an empirical illustration to demonstrate its practical applicability. The results show that several predictors are statistically significant.

pmc-13247256.title: How agricultural socialized services pilot policies can reduce the urban-rural income gap
pmc-13247256.creator: YueXin Yuan, LianGang Zhang, Ting Xiang, PuMing He
pmc-13247256.description: The implementation of China’s pilot policies on agricultural socialized services is not only of great significance for increasing farmers’ income and narrowing the urban-rural income gap in China, but also conducive to achieving the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

pmc-13255163.title: A case of inappropriate thyroid-stimulating hormone secretion syndrome after thalidomide treatment
pmc-13255163.creator: Yanju Zhu, Juan Chen
pmc-13255163.description: Thalidomide is used for the management of several diseases, including the treatment of certain dermatological conditions. We report a case of thyroid dysfunction, characterized by a high serum thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) level accompanied by high free triiodothyronine (FT3) and free thyroxine (FT4), in a patient with preexisting hypothyroidism and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection during thalidomide treatment.

pmc-13571623.title: Nanoparticle-Based Therapeutic Strategies for Pathological Cardiac Hypertrophy: Preclinical Advances, Translational Challenges, and Future Perspectives
pmc-13571623.creator: Mengyue Yang, Jinhui Wu
pmc-13571623.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Pathological cardiac hypertrophy is a major contributor to heart failure and is characterized by complex molecular mechanisms involving transcriptional and epigenetic regulation, signal transduction, metabolic remodeling, inflammatory responses, and extracellular matrix remodeling. Although conventional pharmaceutical treatments may alleviate the progression of cardiac hypertrophy, their clinical effectiveness is limited by poor cardiac selectivity, systemic side effects, and limited efficacy in reverseing pathological remodeling.

pmc-13650436.title: Outcomes, survival, mortality, and major adverse events in aortic valve replacement surgeries in Africa: A systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13650436.creator: Victory Bassey Effiom, Victor Oluwafemi Femi-Lawal, Atharv Vivek Oak, Oluwasegun John Oyesola, Fatma Kamal Ahmed, Samuel Ghislain Junior Fodop, Michael James Anayo, Achanga Bill-Smith Anyinkeng, Jonas Paul Ibekwe, Kolawole Victor Olalekan, Samuel Mesfin Girma, Daniel Brabi, Ahmet Kilic
pmc-13650436.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectivesAortic valve replacement (AVR) is the definitive treatment for severe aortic valve disease, yet outcome data from Africa remain scarce. This systematic review and meta-analysis assessed survival, mortality, and major adverse events after AVR across Africa.MethodsAdhering to Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic reviews and Meta-Analyses guidelines, we searched PubMed, Embase, and Web of Science for studies reporting AVR outcomes in African populations, covering randomized trials, cohort studies, case series, and case reports.
